basis: Revenue +30% to a record $2.03bn and non-GAAP EPS $2.58 (+66%), 'exceeding guidance on every metric', with all-flash +47% and billings +36%, and FY27 revenue and EPS guidance 'significantly raised' (non-GAAP EPS $9.73-10.03).
